'''Power relays''' were stations used to transfer power from primary power sources. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ashaar Khorda]] sought to use a power relay to destroy the [[Infant of Shaa]], creating an explosion that would consume [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, he was foiled by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], and [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]].
